marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Success stories : Lee Kuan Yew = 华人系列 : 李光耀 | Success Stories : LEE KUAN YEW = Cheng gong hua ren xi lie : li guang yao

A documentary produced by Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK) which provides insights into Mr. Lee Kuan Yew's life, personality, family values and his philosophy of government. In part I of the documentary, Lee recounts his personal experience growing up as a 19 year old boy under the Japanese Occupation and tells how through a stroke of luck, he missed the lorry ride that sent young Chinese boys to the beach to be shot. In part II, Lee's family values, personal lifestyle and character goes under scrutiny by his friends and colleagues. Lee led Singapore to Independence and was sworn in as Singapore's first Prime Minister on 5 June, 1959. He retired in 1990. Singapore survived and thrived through the able and far-sighted leadership of Lee Kuan Yew. Under his guidance, Singapore also became a financial and industrial powerhouse, despite a lack of abundant natural resources
